headline.text: L1 Sollich 2 took *4 allergen attempts* to clear C1 belt after 3rd-shift cleaning gaps and unsigned paperwork — now running on rework pallets

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 started 1st shift with tunnel 3 not ready and discovered widespread cleaning paperwork failures from 3rd shift — C1 belt failed allergen 3 times before passing on the 4th attempt at 11:50, White Z belt found with chocolate residue and crossed-out paperwork. Running on regular pallets flagged as rework because all 300 PECO-HT Mexico pallets were misused by L3. Sollich 1 found a metal screw in product at 16:25, replaced and validated X-ray by 16:53. Sollich 3 cleaned jar area that was incorrectly marked green.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 lost PTL pump at 13:30, replaced and back running by 16:53. White chocolate continues to clog the inclusion auger and cause blowoffs at the 2nd chicane despite cleaning the cross belt every 30 minutes. Marco from TG adjusted film wrapper speed from 900 to 700 to reduce breaks. ML3 had a brief HMI screen failure (13:45–14:00). FFS found a box label in the trash that was never entered into the system. Plant on level 2 cleaning only for 3rd shift.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 had a 13-minute stop for a Gondola test (11:25–11:38). Truffle line completed the run and level 2 clean; 2 pallets of V3 film show in the system but can't be located. MF Matrix pouch weights running high — checkweigher max raised 5g to 480g but now adding 1–2 extra pieces per pouch, which may short the order. Truffle 1 and ML4 both lost temper simultaneously around 23:50, possibly from a power flicker.

notes.text: Rain forecast Saturday afternoon through Tuesday; facilities will report leaks as they occur for repair after weather clears.
Cleaning rags inventory: L1 220, L2 295, L3 720 as of 10/09.

resolved.title: Metal screw found in Sollich 1 X-ray
resolved.summary: Screw detected in bag at 16:25 during routine X-ray check — maintenance and QA inspected line to locate source and validate X-ray rejection.
resolved.resolution: Source identified (likely Eaglestone conveyor), screw replaced, X-ray validated with test washer at 16:53 — "screw has been put back into place. Another X-Ray check was done and all bags were kicked out perfectly."

resolved.title: Sollich 3 jar area marked clean but not cleaned
resolved.summary: Jar area was signed off green on the cleaning sheet but still had residue from the last level 4 clean.
resolved.resolution: Katya cleaned jar area manually and will skip MM cleaning until next week since MM's are not scheduled.

resolved.title: Sollich 2 tunnel 3 allergen clearance delay
resolved.summary: Line started 07:06 but tunnel 3 had not passed visual inspection, ATP, or allergen — product held in tunnels while QA re-cleaned and re-tested.
resolved.resolution: Tunnel 3 allergen passed at 08:35 — "Ready to run! She's all yours, good luck!" (Joseph Scott)

resolved.title: ML2 PTL pump fault
resolved.summary: PTL pump faulted out at 13:30, line down while maintenance replaced the unit and brought it back to temp.
resolved.resolution: Pump reinstalled at 14:38, heated up, started running back through the flow wrapper at 16:53 (Brandon Lance).

resolved.title: ML3 HMI screen failure
resolved.summary: HMI screen turned off at 13:45, line stopped awaiting maintenance.

resolved.title: ML4 Gondola test stop
resolved.summary: Stefan needed to run a test on the Gondola, line stopped at 11:25.

needs_attention.title: PECO-HT Mexico pallets missing — all 300 used by L3
needs_attention.summary: Sollich 2 needs PECO-HT pallets with Mexico heat-treated stamp for export run; spec calls for them but warehouse discovered all 300 received 9/22 were used by L3 as regular Peco pallets.
needs_attention.status: Running on regular pallets flagged as rework — QA tagging each full pallet, product cannot leave plant. Brett ordering replacement pallets from Chicago. Kirk noted HT pallets ship from Chicago, not local like regular Peco.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 C1 belt allergen failures and cleaning gaps
needs_attention.summary: C1 belt was signed off green by 3rd shift but never passed allergen test — failed 3 consecutive tests (09:41, 10:30, 11:26) before passing on the 4th attempt; C2 and C3 also not signed off by QA; White Z belt found with chocolate residue and crossed-out paperwork with no notes.
needs_attention.status: C1 allergen passed on 4th attempt at 11:50; QA inspecting White Z and doing preops. Curt, Jody, and Joseph scheduling meeting to review 3rd-shift paperwork failures.

needs_attention.title: ML2 film breaking during filling
needs_attention.summary: Flow wrapper film breaking when machine transitions to filling mode — Marco from TG believes machine not slowing down as programmed.
needs_attention.status: Marco adjusted intended speed during filling from 900 to 700 at 17:27. Checking with programmer on whether DW64 / DW65 settings are correct. Unclear if issue fully resolved.

needs_attention.title: ML2 white chocolate flow and blowoff issues
needs_attention.summary: Line continues to have problems with white chocolate flowing through the inclusion auger into the depositor, and frequent blowoffs after the 2nd chicane and at the twin belts despite cleaning cross conveyor every 30 minutes.
needs_attention.status: Auger clear as of 19:16 but buildup continues at magnet. Cross belt being cleaned every 30 min. Brandon noted correction — auger clear, just buildup at magnet.

needs_attention.title: FFS box label not entered into system
needs_attention.summary: Inventory check found a box label in the trash that had not been scanned or entered into the system.
needs_attention.status: Brandon will talk with line lead on Monday. Label documented and flagged for follow-up.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix pouch weight variance may short order
needs_attention.summary: Pouches running high on checkweigher (target 465–470g), machine rejecting and causing rework — single piece weight at 14.8g; raising max weight to 480g now adds 1–2 extra pieces per pouch.
needs_attention.status: Checkweigher max raised by 5g to 480g at 16:39 to reduce rejects, but now overfilling pouches with extra pieces. Andrea said as of 18:52 we will likely fall short of completing the order. Truffle team asked to label WIP pallets with low/max weight — pallets arriving unlabeled.

needs_attention.title: Truffle FW film pallets missing from inventory
needs_attention.summary: 2 pallets of V3 film (40201-V3) for Toffee bars show in the system but IMS cannot locate them in the warehouse.
needs_attention.status: V4 for Raspberry is on-site; 2 pallets V3 in system but physically missing as of 11:24. Rose flagged.
